name: Echo of Illasera
backstory:
In life, Illasera was once a Bhaalspawn and a member of the Five which was an alliance between five powerful Bhaalspawns formed by Amelyssan, Bhaal's high priestess, that sought to slaughter their siblings in exchange for power. Illasera was tasked to kill the famous Bhaalspawn known as Gorion's Ward and ambushed them and their party at the . The two fought, but Gorion's Ward ultimately defeated Illasera, making her the first of the Five to have been slain.

Bhaal was a century after Illasera's death. After this Sarevok Anchev was able to bring her back as an Echo to serve in the Murder Tribunal along with Abazigal, Sendai and Amelyssan.
voice_hint: ghost, elf (former) sorcerer (voiced by Fenella Fudge)
